$comment: The beat menu for the prototype slice: what the rules allow in each of the three areas, one authored line each, and the engine action behind it. Notes name the check or the cost as the design prototype prints them. Phase 5 replaces this with gated options read from the adventure file.
title: The 5 Treasures: prototype menu
label: invention

records.title: Force the shut gate
records.line: Wood, iron, and a willow that has grown around both.

records.cite: MH p.31 (R40, R41); spec.md, sealed rules
records.title: Rest by the stream
records.line: A night here costs you the morning.

records.title: Go in, to the Attendants room
Face the Dexterous Ghost
records.line: It does not bleed, and it does not hurry.

records.title: Take the jade vase
records.line: Muttonfat jade, and a label you have not read yet.

records.title: Back to the entrance
records.line: The gate is where you left it.

records.title: On, to the Dining Hall
records.line: The smell of a kitchen, and the noise of one.

records.title: Cross the hall unseen
records.line: Whether anyone looks up is not in your hands.

records.title: Back to the Attendants room
records.line: The vase is still on its pedestal, or it is not.

records.title: Leave the cave
records.line: Daylight, and a road that goes more than one way.
